integrity.critical_source_input: Harashita Lemma 7.7 gives the explicit Hermitian-to-Fermat quotient and its degree; Proposition 7.9 gives the p-local saturation and discriminant-group annihilator bounds.
integrity.new_step: The cyclic subgroup generated by p has a unique order-two element, forcing the least admissible exponent to be half the multiplicative order and thereby optimizing the entire Hermitian-cover family.
integrity.unproved_limit: No equality for the actual saturation exponent is claimed.

scientific_limitations: The power \(p^{md/2}\) is the smallest annihilator bound produced by the diagonal Hermitian-cover descent, not a claim about the exact exponent of the true saturation quotient.
The statement is restricted to \(N\ge3\) and to the supersingular congruence regime in which some power of \(p\) is congruent to \(-1\) modulo \(N\).
Unimodularity away from \(p\) is asserted only at primes not dividing \(e_0=(p^{d/2}+1)/N\).
title: The multiplicative order gives the smallest Hermitian-cover saturation bound
